description: This file defines the class CurlMultiHandler, which manages asynchronous HTTP requests using cURL's multi interface within the Guzzle HTTP client library.

classes.name: CurlMultiHandler
classes.description: Handles multiple cURL requests asynchronously, allowing for efficient parallel HTTP calls within Guzzle.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with optional configuration such as handle factory, select timeout, and additional cURL options.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the cURL multi handle resource.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the cURL multi handle resource on object destruction.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Begins an asynchronous request and returns a Promise representing the response.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Performs one iteration of the cURL multi event loop, handling request progress.

methods.name: tickInQueue
methods.description: Runs cURL multi execution within the event queue to avoid blocking.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the event loop until all requests are completed.

methods.name: addRequest
methods.description: Adds new request handles to the multi handle for management.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels and removes a handle from the multi handle.

methods.name: processMessages
methods.description: Processes completed cURL messages and resolves corresponding promises.

methods.name: timeToNext
methods.description: Calculates the time until the next scheduled delayed handle.
